background: the pinned NSS build has no PKIX implementation, so CERT_PKIXVerifyCert returns PR_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. The legacy verifier CERT_VerifyCertNow is exported and was used instead.

defect_found_and_fixed.description: anchors were imported and trusted without checking basicConstraints, so a self-signed end-entity certificate acted as a trust root and accepted an unrelated leaf
defect_found_and_fixed.fix: CERT_IsCADERCert gates every anchor; a non-CA anchor is refused with code 912

limits: standalone verification tool, not yet wired into the adapter or the JS path
revocation (OCSP/CRL) is not checked because that engine is also absent
the temporary NSS database lives in the container tmpfs and is discarded
